mission.objective: Compile the exact accepted E3.5 population workset plus immutable upstream TF/ENV snapshot context into a deterministic snapshot-bound temporal/disturbance program without owning canonical time, environment history, persistence, network, transaction, or production authority.
mission.completion_condition: Exact E3.6 candidate is frozen, deterministic and fail-closed; exact accepted E3.5 and TF/ENV context identities are enforced; all HIGH-risk predicates, evidence map, critique, fresh Reviewer and independent Verifier complete; checkpoint is proposed but not self-accepted.

scope: Implement E3.6 as a research-only deterministic temporal compiler. E3.5 is the sole ecology predecessor. Exact accepted E3.1 is read only as upstream TF/ENV snapshot context. Emit snapshot-bound seasonal/disturbance envelopes and refresh semantics while refusing to infer canonical history/future from a single snapshot.
required_outputs: Exact accepted E3.5 workset binding with raw-byte/Git-blob/SHA/workset/provenance identity
Exact immutable accepted E3.1 TF/ENV context binding without ecology-predecessor authority
Research-only E3.6 contract and Draft 2020-12 output schema
Deterministic temporal/disturbance compiler with verified serialization capability
Explicit single-snapshot seasonality unresolved semantics rather than invented history/future
Fresh Reviewer and independent Verifier evidence before checkpoint proposal

E3.6 would require ECO to create or rewrite canonical ENV history

design_brief.problem_statement: Accepted E3.5 provides deterministic multi-scale population worksets, but PlanetEcologyProgram still lacks the temporal_disturbance_program stage needed to bind ecology work to snapshot time/environment semantics.
design_brief.current_behavior: E3.5 carries stable planet/time/spatial identities and aggregate work basis, while accepted E3.1 carries exact TF/ENV semantic references and per-spatial-key observed environment/disturbance values. There is only one accepted time snapshot, so non-degenerate seasonal history is not evidenced.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Compile deterministic per-active-spatial-key temporal/disturbance envelopes anchored to exact accepted E3.5 work and exact upstream TF/ENV snapshot bytes. With one snapshot, output explicit degenerate envelopes and UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SNAPSHOT seasonality; never fabricate future/history. New owner snapshots require recompilation rather than ECO time mutation.
alternatives_considered: Infer a synthetic annual cycle from latitude and stable_time_key
Treat stable_time_key text as canonical numeric time
Use exact accepted E3.5 as ecology predecessor and exact accepted E3.1 only as immutable TF/ENV context, failing closed to degenerate envelopes when temporal history is insufficient
design_brief.selected_design: E3.5 remains sole ecology predecessor. Accepted E3.1 is a read-only contextual dependency for TF/ENV observations. For each active E3.5 stable_spatial_key, bind the exact E3.1 sample and emit an envelope whose min/anchor/max equal the observed value until a new exact owner snapshot exists. Mark seasonality UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SNAPSHOT and refresh only by recompilation from new owner bytes.
design_brief.why_selected: It advances the DAG without inventing time or environmental history, preserves exact accepted E3.5 ecology truth, gives E3.7 a deterministic temporal section, and makes missing temporal evidence explicit rather than silently simulated.
non_goals: No ENV history database or forecast authority
No invented annual/seasonal cycle from latitude or opaque time keys
expected_risks: Single-snapshot evidence is accidentally promoted into predictive seasonal truth
E3.1 is accidentally treated as a second ecology predecessor and earlier stages are bypassed
Plain reconstructed JSON obtains serialization authority without exact raw traversal
Inactive E3.1 cells are emitted as active temporal population work
Temporal output encodes canonical TF/ENV ownership claims
validation_plan: Pin exact accepted E3.5 and accepted E3.1 raw bytes by Git blob and SHA-256
Recompute E3.5 workset/provenance and E3.1 snapshot hash where defined
Require verified-input capabilities for authoritative build/serialize
Map only active E3.5 stable_spatial_keys to exact E3.1 samples
Prove each active E3.5 basis key is covered exactly once by temporal envelopes
Prove min=anchor=max for single-snapshot environmental/disturbance envelopes
Prove seasonality remains UNRESOLVED_SINGLE_SNAPSHOT and stable_time_key is opaque
Reject TF/ENV ownership, history rewrite, forecast, persistence/network/transaction authority fields
Prove NO_ACTIVE_POPULATION yields zero envelopes without inventing work
Run schema validation, input permutation tests, fresh-process byte identity, critique, evidence map, Reviewer and Verifier
